lines.text: An angel with a great chain binds the dragon and throws him into the Abyss for a thousand years.
Those beheaded for their testimony of Moses come to life and reign with Christ as priests for a thousand years.
Satan deceives Gog and Magog, and fire from heaven consumes the army surrounding the camp of the saints.
The devil is thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet already were.
The dead stand before the great white throne and are judged by their prayers, as recorded in the books.
